jobs.title: AI Infrastructure Accelerating GPU-to-GPU communications in clusters
jobs.description: AI infrastructure Networking is the “new compute” in the AI data center. Our high-speed connectivity solutions are core to this transformation. AECs AI training requires massive GPU clusters and demanding backend infrastructure. Credo’s AECs provide the reliability and scalability to connect server racks and accelerator clusters. Optical solutions In AI compute clusters, multiple servers comprised of tightly coupled GPUs must function as one GPU to prevent performance bottlenecks. Credo optical products are essential to GPU-to-GPU communications. PCIe retimers Retimers enable PCIe signals to travel beyond a single server enclosure, supporting rack-scale deployments. Credo PCIe retimer solutions offer a low-latency, high-throughput open solution well-suited for scale-up networks. Ethernet retimers AI scale-out architectures require connectivity between compute nodes, storage, applications, and other networked resources. Credo’s widely deployed Ethernet retimers enable data to transmit seamlessly in these complex environments. jobs.title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: We are seeking a Senior Infrastructure Engineer to own the operation, reliability, security, and continuous improvement of our global server infrastructure. The role is primarily focused on physical and virtual servers, operating systems, storage, backup, identity, monitoring, automation, and cloud compute, while providing broad Tier 2–3 troubleshooting across systems, networking, and security. The engineer will resolve complex incidents, lead infrastructure projects, and partner with network, security, cloud, development, and operational teams to deliver scalable, compliant, and cost-effective services. Why Credo Purpose: We invest in what matters. From meaningful-future shaping projects to competitive compensation, we empower you to grow your career while making a lasting impact. People: Connection starts within. We collaborate, celebrate wins, and create an environment where everyone can do their best work. Possibilities: Our belief shapes what’s next. Our technology powers the most reliable and energy-efficient connections around the world – and our team powers new products and markets that come next. Basic Qualifications Five or more years of experience in infrastructure or systems engineering with substantial hands-on Tier 2–3 responsibility for enterprise server operations, complex incident resolution, and production support. Strong administration skills across Linux and Windows Server, VMware or comparable virtualization, cloud compute, SAN/NAS storage, backup and recovery, Active Directory or IPA, and performance monitoring. Working knowledge of DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP, routing, switching, firewalls, VPNs, segmentation, identity, access control, system hardening, vulnerability management, and security incident support. Experience with PowerShell, Bash, Python, Ansible, or comparable tools, plus ITSM, change, patch, asset, monitoring, and configuration-management processes. Proven ability to diagnose cross-platform issues, perform root-cause analysis, lead infrastructure projects, develop technical documentation, and coordinate effectively with global network, security, cloud, and application teams. Preferred Qualifications Red Hat, Microsoft, VMware, or equivalent enterprise infrastructure certification. Experience with high-availability clustering, enterprise backup, disaster recovery, storage integration, patch orchestration, and server lifecycle management. Our technology powers high-speed optical connectivity for hyperscale datacenters, delivering industry-leading performance, scalability, and reliability. We're hiring a Production Controller to join our Operations team and take a key role in managing the day-to-day execution of our semiconductor supply chain. This role owns the critical front-end processes of our semiconductor supply chain, coordinating day-to-day execution across external silicon FABs, wafer-level testing facilities, and dicing vendors. Dustphotonics, now part of Credo, develops cutting-edge technology in Silicon Photonics which is revolutionizing connectivity and communication in data centers.
